name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SEO Content Specialist | On-Page SEO, Content Systems & AI-Assisted Workflows
summary: SEO and content practitioner with 15+ years in agency and marketing-operations work, owning on-page SEO, technical audits, and content production directly for B2B and local service clients. Writes thought leadership, guides, and landing pages personally, builds reusable templates and messaging frameworks instead of starting from scratch each time, and runs GA4/Search Console monitoring to catch underperforming content before it becomes a bigger problem. Uses Claude and ChatGPT daily inside real production workflows, and has built and documented SOPs for marketing and operational processes across concurrent client engagements.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, landing pages, and educational guides for B2B and local-service clients, building reusable templates adapted per brand and vertical rather than rebuilt from scratch each time.

Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor and SERP research, implementing on-page fixes - titles, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, alt text - directly inside client CMS platforms.
Track GA4 and Google Search Console performance across concurrent client accounts, identifying underperforming pages and recommending refreshes or consolidation based on what the data shows.
Use Claude and ChatGPT daily inside production content and SEO workflows, developing structured prompts and process documentation that keep output consistent rather than one-off.
Build and document SOPs for client-facing marketing and operational processes, keeping work auditable and repeatable across concurrent engagements in Notion and CRM systems.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Built content toolkits and training materials that equipped 15-20 partners to communicate product value consistently to their own customers.
Advised partners on Google Business Profile optimization and local search visibility as part of a broader reputation-management platform.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for two years, a team of 20 and later a team of 8, including structured feedback and performance coaching to improve individual output quality.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, on-page SEO, and inbound content to improve client traffic and conversion.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
